tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind the board, backlog and lists. The sidebar and top bar sit on it too.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Issue cards, panels, inputs, menus and modals.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, cards and ghost buttons. Also the board column background, so white cards stand out.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, active sidebar item, avatar fill and drop zones while dragging. Text on it is primary-subtle-text or text-primary.

tokens.name: surface-header
tokens.usage: Top bar and page headers (the sprint header on the board).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline for card edges, dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and checkboxes. At least 3:1 on surface-raised and surface-page in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on every surface token, including surface-selected.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, helper text, placeholders, timestamps and inactive icons on surface-page, surface-raised, surface-hover and surface-selected. At least 4.5:1 on all four in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one filled button per view, links, the focus ring and the selected tab underline. Text and icons on it use on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover. Dark text in the dark theme because primary lightens there.

tokens.name: primary-subtle-text
tokens.usage: Initials in avatars and labels on surface-selected.

tokens.name: status-todo
tokens.usage: To do status icon and column dot, on surface-raised and surface-hover. Always shown beside the status name.

tokens.name: status-todo-bg
tokens.usage: To do status pill fill.

tokens.name: status-todo-text
tokens.usage: Label on status-todo-bg.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: In progress status icon and column dot, on surface-raised and surface-hover. Always shown beside the status name.

tokens.name: status-progress-bg
tokens.usage: In progress status pill fill.

tokens.name: status-progress-text
tokens.usage: Label on status-progress-bg.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Done status icon and column dot, on surface-raised and surface-hover. Always shown beside the status name.

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Done status pill fill.

tokens.name: status-done-text
tokens.usage: Label on status-done-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, error icons, invalid field edges and the Urgent priority icon. Text on a danger fill uses on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Inline error banners and failed-upload rows.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages on danger-bg.

tokens.name: type-epic
tokens.usage: Epic icon colour only. Never fill a card or row with it.

tokens.name: type-story
tokens.usage: Story icon colour only.

tokens.name: type-task
tokens.usage: Task icon colour only.

tokens.name: type-bug
tokens.usage: Bug icon colour only.

tokens.name: type-subtask
tokens.usage: Sub-task icon colour only.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, helper text under fields and counts in column headers.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card metadata, table cells and sidebar items.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default. Card titles, form values, menus and list rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs and the active sidebar item.

styles.name: description
styles.usage: Issue descriptions and comments, where people read longer text.
styles.sample: Users get a reset link by email that expires after one hour.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page and modal titles: Board, Backlog, Create issue.

styles.name: issue-title
styles.usage: The issue title on the issue detail page and side panel.

styles.name: key
styles.usage: Issue keys on cards, rows and breadcrumbs, in text-secondary.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, branch names and code blocks in descriptions and comments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, gap between pills on a card.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a column, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, input horizontal padding, column padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between board columns, panel padding, form field spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding and modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections and between the issue body and its sidebar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding and large page offsets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tags and menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Issue cards, board columns, menus and dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the issue side panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars and count badges.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, tooltips and the command palette. Nothing else gets a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and a card while it is being dragged.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects and the search field.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar holding search, create and the avatar menu.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar with workspace, projects and views.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Sidebar collapsed to icons.

tokens.name: column-width
tokens.usage: Width of a board column.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Issue side panel opened from the board or list.
